VISUALIZATIONS to AMUSE

This is the "About Oddtoe" section, so I might as well show you around. I like and do a lot of types of art. Some of the favorites are street art, projection art, animation, and installation art. Want to amuse and stir the happy emotions of your audience? Welcome to my world.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_heading delimiter_settings="border-bottom-style:solid;|border-bottom-width:1px;|width:50px;|border-bottom-color:#dddddd;" style="style_02" subtitle="The analog world..." title_font_options="tag:h3" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Built Environments[/dfd_heading][vc_column_text css=""]

PHYSICAL THINGS of WHIMSY

I adore the twin arts of garden and park design and sculpture. The logical child of these creative practices is topiary, of course. Therefore, I design in 3d with organic shapes in mind. Lately that has meant giant inflatables, where air does the holding-up. I often slam my shoe at government council meetings, demanding quirkier and more memorable public spaces. (So should you.)[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="55" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="55" screen_tablet_spacer_size="55" screen_mobile_spacer_size="45"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_heading delimiter_settings="border-bottom-style:solid;|border-bottom-width:1px;|width:50px;|border-bottom-color:#dddddd;" style="style_02" subtitle="The universe expands..." title_font_options="tag:h3" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_family:QwigleyRegular"]Three Dimensional & A.I.[/dfd_heading][vc_column_text css=""]

DEEPER DIVES

I love a good third dimension and I also think I'm lucky to live in this new era of artificial intelligence. Those are two things you should know about me. Transforming ideas into tangible, breathtaking realities, Oddtoe specializes in 3D design and immersive spatial experiences tailored for private clients and government park planners. This is an artistic craft that brings visions to life through cutting-edge visualization, landscape design, and site-specific installations. Whether designing sculptural outdoor spaces, conceptualizing urban parks, or crafting bespoke private topiary gardens, every project is a fusion of artistic sensibility and technical precision.

For those seeking to push beyond conventional design, immersive experiences offer a new frontier in spatial storytelling. From interactive light installations to topographically inspired 3D sculptures, each piece is meticulously designed to engage and inspire. Government planners and landscape architects benefit from highly detailed visual proposals that communicate complex ideas with clarity, while private clients enjoy bespoke design solutions that reflect their unique aesthetic and spatial needs. Whether shaping a tranquil retreat or a dynamic public space, the focus remains on creating environments that not only serve a purpose but leave a lasting emotional impact.

Questions & Answers

About Oddtoe

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-3" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14"][vc_tta_section title="Who is Oddtoe?" tab_id="faqaboutoddtoe-1-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Oddtoe is a Melbourne artist and animator working across generative AI animation, experiential design and public art. He has drawn under the Oddtoe name since 1996, with professional work since 2006 for organisations such as National Geographic.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What kind of art does Oddtoe make?" tab_id="faqaboutoddtoe-2-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Two kinds: animation and physical work. The animation side covers generative AI animation, documentary and factual animation, and character design. The physical side covers kinetic and public sculpture, installation, projection, prop design and fabrication, topiary and sensory garden design, and robotics. Comedy writing runs through most of it.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Does Oddtoe use AI in animation?" tab_id="faqaboutoddtoe-3-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yes, in production every day. The studio runs a hybrid pipeline: generative AI produces imagery and movement, rigging keeps characters consistent, and traditional motion design carries the type, graphics and edit. Twenty years of drawing sits underneath — the AI is a tool in a trained hand, and art direction stays with one person.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Where is Oddtoe based?" tab_id="faqaboutoddtoe-4-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

Melbourne, Australia, and available for commissions in Los Angeles and Berlin.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What is Babbling with Baobabs?" tab_id="faqaboutoddtoe-5-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

A live children’s comedy show commissioned for Signal by the City of Melbourne and performed at the Melbourne International Comedy Festival. Professor Oddtoe — a scientist whose inventions include the Watermelhelmet and the cat selfie stick — unveils a machine that lets people talk to trees, and introduces Bab, a talking baby baobab who wakes to a nonsense chant, demands a bucket of coffee, and answers questions from kids in the audience live. Part stand-up, part science lesson, part digital puppetry through real-time projection.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What original stories and series has Oddtoe created?" tab_id="faqaboutoddtoe-6-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

The Oddtoe TV Show — an animated series with a full pitch bible — alongside Wire Taps, Date Night Confessionals, Gag Cartoonist Syndication and the Original Stories collection, all at oddtoe.com.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What is Oddtoe’s animation conferences guide?" tab_id="faqaboutoddtoe-7-2026"][vc_column_text css=""]

An annually updated guide to the world’s animation conferences and festivals at oddtoe.com/animation-conferences/, ranking in Google’s top three for “animation conferences”. It lists dates, venues and deadlines, month by month, kept current year-round.

Innovation from Oddtoe

Need an Experiential Designer?

[vc_column_text css=””]

My background is in cartooning, graphic design, and data visualization so you’ll see those influences in my humor, art, and way of thinking.

[/vc_column_text]

If you're into...

Arts & Entertainment

[vc_column_text css=””]

VISUALIZATIONS to AMUSE

This is the “About Oddtoe” section, so I might as well show you around. I like and do a lot of types of art. Some of the favorites are street art, projection art, animation, and installation art. Want to amuse and stir the happy emotions of your audience? Welcome to my world.

[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

The analog world...

Built Environments

[vc_column_text css=””]

PHYSICAL THINGS of WHIMSY

I adore the twin arts of garden and park design and sculpture. The logical child of these creative practices is topiary, of course. Therefore, I design in 3d with organic shapes in mind. Lately that has meant giant inflatables, where air does the holding-up. I often slam my shoe at government council meetings, demanding quirkier and more memorable public spaces. (So should you.)[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

The universe expands...

Three Dimensional & A.I.

[vc_column_text css=””]

DEEPER DIVES

I love a good third dimension and I also think I’m lucky to live in this new era of artificial intelligence. Those are two things you should know about me. Sculpture, animation, and prop art design are what I’m into — all visual art that leverages 3D and AI, if needed.[/vc_column_text][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner]

Pseudonyms aplenty...

About Oddtoe

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/4″][vc_column_text css=””]Since 1996, I’ve been running my illustration, animations, and comedic writing under the pseudonym, Oddtoe.

Oddtoe has taken on new forms over the years. Since the pandemic in 2020, I pushed aside is my pen-and-ink style of illustration, and picked up an iPad Pro, experimented heavily with digital caricature and imaging compositing.[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/4″][vc_column_text css=””]I’m loving the result and the new tools in this new pipeline of work.

Oddtoe as a business pairs up nicely alongside my data visualization agency, Datalabs. As part of my parent company, Data Arts, Oddtoe is taking on studio animation, art commissions, and 3d design projects.

And of course, my interest in storytelling is — spread like peanut butter — across both brands.[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][vc_column]

Visualizing happy places...

Experience Gardens & Immersive Environments

[vc_column_text css=””]

Transforming ideas into tangible, breathtaking realities, Oddtoe specializes in 3D design and immersive spatial experiences tailored for private clients and government park planners. This is an artistic craft that brings visions to life through cutting-edge visualization, landscape design, and site-specific installations. Whether designing sculptural outdoor spaces, conceptualizing urban parks, or crafting bespoke private topiary gardens, every project is a fusion of artistic sensibility and technical precision.

For those seeking to push beyond conventional design, immersive experiences offer a new frontier in spatial storytelling. From interactive light installations to topographically inspired 3D sculptures, each piece is meticulously designed to engage and inspire. Government planners and landscape architects benefit from highly detailed visual proposals that communicate complex ideas with clarity, while private clients enjoy bespoke design solutions that reflect their unique aesthetic and spatial needs. Whether shaping a tranquil retreat or a dynamic public space, the focus remains on creating environments that not only serve a purpose but leave a lasting emotional impact.

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″]
[vc_single_image image=”15378″ img_size=”large” alignment=”center” style=”vc_box_rounded” css=””][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″]
An easy way to design efficiently in a 3d space is to use organics. Think topiary and vines.

Oddtoe

About the role of geometry in topiary
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]

[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark”][vc_column width=”1/6″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”4/6″]

The Oddtoe Sweet Spot

Spaces & Characters

[vc_column_text css=””]Three-dimensional modeling is what sets up the imagery and animation I create as Oddtoe. Dimensional data is the underlying and reusable asset for character designs and background art.

From an OBJ or FBX model, the value proposition of the studio I run is that visual stories can be told at scale. Generative AI is certainly taking a role in ideation. And with a background in data and 3d, I’m able to run a full-scale animation and design firm with limited overhead.

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″]
[vc_single_image image=”15393″ img_size=”large” alignment=”center” style=”vc_box_rounded” css=””][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/2″]
Generative AI is good at blunt fusion. By that, I mean it's good at jamming two ideas together. This technology – with a human taste-maker at the helm — will show us forms that we've never seen before. Fantastic.
